content.text:
**What I'm telling my son:** I didn't choose anything. I'll ask you, or the bank, before I open one. I'm fairly sure about that. What decided it: the page is four screens of the same rows of numbers, and nowhere does it say in plain words which track is safe like my deposit.

- **Screen 1.** Dark page. Big heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". I chose "קופת גמל להשקעה 143". Under "במה הכסף מושקע" there are many buttons: "עוקב s&p 500", "כספי (שקלי)", "אג"ח ממשלתי", "הלכה יהודית" and more. Then a table, company by company, starting with "הראל".
  - The column I understood best was "דמי ניהול", 0.54% to 0.73%. That's the fee, I know that kind of thing.
  - "אג"ח ממשלות" caught my eye because government bonds are safe. But next to it it says "עוד לא דווח" with an orange "!", and only 5 million ₪. New, so I backed away.
  - "כספי (שקלי)" sounds like money, maybe the closest thing to a deposit, at about 4.25%–4.62% for "3 שנים". I'm not sure if that's per year or for all three years. Next to it "5 שנים" is a lower number, which confused me.
- **Screens 2–4.** The same again for "מור", "אנליסט", "מיטב", "אלטשולר שחם", "הפניקס". I've heard of Harel and Phoenix. The others I don't know, and my bank isn't there at all. Partway through screen 4 I stopped. I was tired and it all looked the same.
- **Didn't read:** screens 5–8. Also the buttons at the top, "השוואה למדד" and "השקעה במדד". To me מדד is the price index on the news.

**Words I didn't understand:** "s&p 500" / "S&P500", "עוקב מדד", "מט"ח", "גמיש", "כספי (שקלי)", "פחות מ־3 שנים", "ההפקדה" next to "ההחיסכון", the little coloured circles, "101%" מניות, and "123 מקור / מחושב / הזנה".

**What bothered me:**
- The grey text under the heading and above the table was hard to read even enlarged.
- Too many numbers on every row.
- Some rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a number.
- The dark background tires the eyes.
- The orange warning at the top, "נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026", made me wonder whether the numbers are even current.
